_comment: APP-05: the requests the patient app makes to submit a lab report (the one lab path: file it, then the server reads it). Pinned on both sides: flutter_app/test/data/health_data_repository_lab_submit_test.dart proves HealthDataRepository.submitLabReport sends exactly these, and tests/integration/patient-lab-report-submit.test.ts proves the migrated schema + RLS + Edge Function accept them. {patient_id} is the signed-in patient's auth user id, {org_id} their clinic (read with org_lookup in patient-lab-report-writes.json), {object} the uuid file name uploaded into the private lab-reports bucket, {sha256} the file's lower-case hex SHA-256, {today} the local date, {report_id} the id the insert returned. The user's file name is never sent.
